description: Terminal control characters are escaped inside quotes as \u and four lowercase hex digits, in msg and in every string value: every C0 control other than LF and CR (tab included), DEL, C1 and the bidi controls U+061C, U+200E, U+200F, U+202A-U+202E and U+2066-U+2069. A value holding one is quoted. Neighbouring characters (U+00A0, U+2010, U+206A) stay as they are.
